## How to use this page

This question bank is organised by topic. Navigate to the theme most relevant to your evaluation, browse the questions, and copy-paste those that fit your needs. Each question includes:
- The **question text**, ready to use
- **Response options** where applicable
- The **source survey** it is drawn from
- A note on **when to use it** (baseline, endline, or both)

Questions are drawn from validated instruments including the **Community Innovation Survey (CIS)**, the **Firms Adoption of Technology Survey (FAT)**, the **World Bank Enterprise Surveys (WBES)**, the **World Management Survey (WMS)**, the **Flash Eurobarometer on SME Digitalisation**, and the **ECB Survey on Access to Finance of Enterprises (SAFE)**.

> **Tip:** Adapting a validated question is faster and more reliable than writing one from scratch — and it allows you to benchmark your results against other studies.
